notes.title: Story mode is available! 📖
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576012/0dbfc53f84fa01fa1bcd66124ab151e02c54079f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Stories Are Live in Passion Rift! 📖[/b][/h2][p][b]
[/b]Your favorite Stars now have their own mini-arcs. Play through a short chain of tasks, grab rewards along the way, and unlock a special date + scene at the end. Simple, guided, and super satisfying.

🙋‍♂️ [b]How It Works? [/b]
• Short & sweet: Each Story is a focused set of tasks you can clear at your own pace. 
• Steady rewards: Every task gives a little something; finishing the Story unlocks the big finale. 
• Play as you like: Tasks match what you already do (Adventures, merges, spending Energy, opening chests). Just keep playing and check off objectives. 
• More time with your faves: Dialogues and a scene that spotlight the Star you’re following. 

🎁 [b]What You Get?[/b] 
• On the way: Currency, items, and other handy goodies for each task you finish. 
• The finale: A short date that leads into a scene: your reward for completing the Story. 

So dive in, chase the rewards, and unlock the scenes!
Don’t let your favorite Star’s story pass you by! See you in game! 

[b]With intent, JNT Corp. Reality Division 
Watching. Waiting. Always filming. 🎥[/b]

notes.title: Meet Iko!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576012/39f47c8b6759e4bdddb8fe826958cd411759b3e7.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dancer. Healer. Kitsune with a glowing tail and a thousand quiet questions.[/b][/h2]

No one knows exactly where Iko was born — not even Iko. Somewhere in Central Europe, between the mist and the myth. She arrived on the island barefoot and beaming, drawn not by fame or fortune, but by the strange pulse of energy she felt beyond the portal.

Her days are full of flowing movement — yoga, dance, acrobatics — always bathed in sunrise or sunset. She offers herbal remedies, crystal readings, and whispered fortunes to anyone willing to listen, treating every moment of connection as sacred.

Flirting? It’s not a tactic. It’s her nature.
She flirts with strangers, silence, sunlight, and sometimes… danger. Especially when Uproar is near.

Iko may seem serene, but beneath the calm lies boundless curiosity and a longing for something she can’t quite name. She doesn't understand human games — she's too trusting, too open — but her warmth makes suspicion melt and strangers stay.

She’s not here to play. She’s here to feel. And maybe, just maybe, to finally remember where she belongs.
[h3][b]
🌸 Wishlist Passion Rift now — and follow Iko into a story of touch, trust, and tails that shimmer in the light.[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578240/Passion_Rift/?utm_source_steampost

notes.title: Meet Minty!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576012/4ab05821a97774c56f078e0344f932214235f97e.png[/img]

[h2]🧜‍♀️ Meet Minty Shellsong — island maintenance girl, part-time tide whisperer, full-time fan of cozy fashion.[/h2]

Sweet, helpful, and just a little weird, Minty knows every pipe, puddle, and palm tree on the island. She fixes leaks, feeds seagulls by name, and talks to water like it’s going to answer back.

Nobody’s quite sure where she came from — and she’s not in a rush to explain. She’d rather compliment your boots.
[b]
🫧 Loves plants, tights, and pretending she’s not slightly magical
🐠 Has strong opinions on hydration and absolutely no filter
🚿 Might disappear for a day… or three[/b]

Sure, she blushes too easily and avoids drama like it’s a puddle of hot lava —
But she’s got her own kind of charm.

Just don’t ask her why her closet is 80% legwear.

[b]✨ Wishlist Passion Rift now — she’ll notice if you don’t.[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578240/Passion_Rift/?utm_source_steampost

notes.title: Meet Itzel!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576012/c37bd825e19aeef2ef00d6fd71b32a168af11fca.png[/img]

She says she’s human.
She looks divine.
She’ll never tell you the full truth — but you’ll still fall for her anyway.

Itzel arrived through the Rift before anyone else — or so the whispers go. Officially, she works with JNT Corp. Unofficially… some say she’s far older than the portal itself.

Centuries of seduction, secrets, and survival have left her jaded — but never cold.
[b]
📜 Collector of myths. Breaker of hearts. Master of manipulation.
🔮 Feels nothing — but lives for pleasure.
🔥 Sleeps with whoever she pleases. For fun. For distraction. For research.[/b]

Her body is borrowed. Her past is buried.
Her smile? Dangerous.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576012/a4ab1c4bf2d256ce5d7233c7cd6d6ad0e61c69ac.gif[/img]

You won’t know what she is until it’s far too late — and by then, you won’t want to leave.

[h3]✨ Wishlist Passion Rift now — and get lost in the gaze of a creature older than history.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578240/Passion_Rift/?utm_source_steampost

notes.title: Meet Andie!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576012/03f01c7408f09473f5c21ffd524a987b2aa49add.png[/img]

[h2]
You don’t flirt with Andie.
You negotiate — and she always gets the better deal.[/h2]

Raised by a corporate dynasty, armed with elite education and a black belt in BJJ, Andie climbed JNT Corp’s ranks with elegance and ruthless precision. Now, as Executive Director of the Passion Rift show, she’s the unseen force pulling every string — and snapping those who resist.

Her gaze lingers like a flame that knows how to hurt.
There’s something... otherworldly in how she moves. And when she smiles? It’s never just polite.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576012/6e649f08959d86ceac7a9f3f065dcb5f91a0b1bc.gif[/img]

[b]💼 Ice-cold intellect. Brutal efficiency. Killer heels.
♟️ Doesn’t do romance — but if you’re lucky, she’ll use you.
🔥 Fights with precision. Leads with fire.[/b]

Some say she’s not entirely human.
Others say she doesn’t care enough to correct them.

[h3]✨ Wishlist Passion Rift now — and try not to fall under her spell.[/h3]
